macro.text: Nasdaq slid into correction territory after Thursday's worst session since 2020
Oil rose on fears of renewed US-Iran conflict after midterms despite a growing supply glut
Gold headed for its best week since August as the US political shift lifted bonds
Asian currencies were mixed as the yen gained on risk aversion and Taiwan's dollar broke 33
Chinese firms' profit margins trailed global peers as domestic demand stayed weak
IRS unveiled higher 2027 tax brackets and standard deductions amid inflation adjustment

corporate.note: Shares rebounded sharply after its fastest sales growth in nearly four years on AI-protection demand
Company said $4 billion in annualized revenue is being pushed to next year at a customer's request
Tesla and SpaceX combined lost over $450 billion in market cap as midterms stoke political risk for Musk
Huang asked to brief Congress after report Trump was briefed on alleged Nvidia-China intelligence ties
Stock rallied after a new cloud-computing deal with backlog tied to investment-grade counterparties
Stock is closing in on its May record high as the retailer's turnaround gains traction
Asian chipmakers including TSMC, Samsung and SK Hynix tumbled tracking Wall Street's Nasdaq selloff

frontPage.watch: Watch the 8:30am ET jobs report for labor-market signals and any fresh Iran-related oil headlines after the AI-driven equity rout.

esForecast.footnote: Ranges cover the full ~23-hour futures session, not just the New York cash session. Sample 3733 sessions from 2012-01-01. Model: ln(next range %) = -5.835 + 0.971×ln(VIX) + 0.315×ln(ATR5 %), R² 54%. Out-of-sample band hit rate 47%. On FOMC, payrolls and CPI days the range is raised 23%, 15% and 6% (how much bigger those sessions ran than the model, 2012-2026).
